text: MLabs is a global technology company with a strong commitment to research and development. We are a team of highly-skilled engineers, developers, and researchers working to create innovative solutions for the future of technology. The AI team includes Mark Bedworth, an eminent researcher who has been working in the field for a number of decades. It also includes Nathaniel Lane, whose Master's thesis dealt with the use of neural networks to predict anti-cancer peptides. The CEO of MLabs is Mark Florisson, who resides in The Netherlands and has contributed to many groundbreaking projects, including Cython.
